# The apps themselves must stay crawlable on purpose: every page carries
# <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow"> (generated by scripts/build.mjs). Search engines must
# be able to read a page to see that tag – blocking it here would hide the tag, and a shared link could
# still end up in search results. So never add "Disallow: /".
#
# GitHub Pages also serves every other file of the repository (README.md, scripts/, tests/ …).
# Those are not HTML and cannot carry the noindex tag (GitHub Pages cannot send an X-Robots-Tag
# header), so they are kept away from crawlers here. They are public on github.com anyway.
User-agent: *
Disallow: /*.md$
Disallow: /LICENSE
Disallow: /package.json
Disallow: /package-lock.json
Disallow: /playwright.config.mjs
Disallow: /scripts/
Disallow: /tests/
Disallow: /template/
Disallow: /.github/
Disallow: /.githooks/
Disallow: /.claude/
